description: Drag the source element (ref or selector) onto the target element (targetRef or targetSelector), using the real mouse API. Options: force, timeoutMs. Returns: { ok, session_id, source, target }. Errors: SELECTOR_NO_MATCH / REF_NOT_FOUND (carries similar_refs), ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE (retryable), NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (a side missing or both ref+selector given).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

targetRef.description: Drop-target ref. Provide targetRef OR targetSelector.

targetSelector.description: Drop-target CSS/text selector. Provide targetRef OR targetSelector.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

name: electron_drag
title: Drag one element onto another
